Security finding for the owner (attempt 2 input): psvensson/lagrange is public and User-owned, so repository runners have no runner groups and any workflow whose labels match is eligible, including fork pull_request runs whose YAML the fork controls. The fork PR approval policy is already all_external_contributors (strictest) and must stay so; approving a fork run while PR gates route to the lab equals running that fork's code as peter on a home host. Collaborators: psvensson only. actions/permissions: allowed_actions all, sha_pinning_required false (workflows already pin by SHA).

Attempt 2 design written to evidence/design-note.md, awaiting the lead's decision; no workflow, runner or setting changed. Recommendation: keep pull-request gates hosted after attempt 1 (PR #188); a lab route conflicts with home-lab.md ('Do not attach trusted home machines to pull-request workflows in the public Lagrange repository'), the ci.yml header and the hardening contract assertion, so it is an owner policy change (R26).
